Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Consolidated Terms & Conditions 1. Foreclosure of Contract: If the services are no longer required by the Department/User, the contract may be foreclosed at any time by giving 15 days' prior notice in writing to the Service Provider. Payment shall be made only for the act ual period of service rendered up to the date of foreclosure, and no claim for compensation, loss of profit, or damages shall be entertained by the Department/User on this account. 2. Temporary Suspension and Resumption of Service: In the event the Department/User desires to temporarily suspend the service for a specific period due to u nforeseen administrative or operational reasons, the Service Provider shall comply with such suspension in structions upon prior intimation. The service shall be resumed and/or the contract period extended corres pondingly on the same terms, conditions, and rates as per the requirement of the Department/User. No pa yment for the suspended period or any claim on this account shall be entertained by the Department/User . 3. All-Inclusive Monthly Hire Charge (Including EV Charging):

The quoted monthly hire charge shall be strictly all-inclusive, covering driver remuneration (including over time/allowances, if any, within duty norms), all electricity/EV charging costs (whether at public DC f ast-charging stations, commercial hubs, or private premises), comprehensive zero-depreciation ins urance premiums (explicitly covering EV High-Voltage Battery Protect and water-ingress/short-circuit d amage), periodic mechanical/electrical maintenance, cost of lubricants/coolants, high-voltage and auxiliary battery replacement/upkeep costs, statutory vehicle taxes, and all other incidental charges. 4. Toll, Permit, and Parking Charges: No extra payment shall be admissible towards toll gate charges, inter-state/commercial permit fees, or par king charges; all such expenses shall be borne entirely by the Service Provider. 5. EV Readiness, Range, and Charging During Duty: Daily State of Charge (SoC): The vehicle must report for duty every day with at least 85%–90% State of Charge (SoC) and a minimum certified real-world driving range of [250 / 300] km per fu ll charge (adjust to match the vehicle model selected). Low charge or battery degradation shall not be accepted as grounds for delay or refusal of duty. Charging Protocol: Routine charging shall be carried out outside normal duty hours. If top-up char ging is required during outstation or extended duty, the Service Provider shall utilize a DC Fast Ch arger (CCS2) to minimize downtime. Charging time during duty hours caused by reporting with ins ufficient charge shall not be counted as payable duty/overtime hours. 6. Charging Accessories, Breakdown Backup, and Commercial EV Registration: Onboard Equipment: The vehicle must carry a functional OEM-supplied 15A portable charger, Type-2 AC charging cable, and safety adapters at all times. Replacement Vehicle: In the event of breakdown, battery fault, or charging failure, the Service Pr ovider shall arrange an equivalent replacement vehicle within 2 hours at no extra cost. Statutory Compliance: The vehicle must hold valid commercial transport registration (Green Nu mber Plate with yellow lettering), valid fitness certificate, and commercial permit under the Motor Vehicles Act.
